title: 01 · Normalization
source:
# Compare x += 1 with its normalized AST: x = x + 1.
x = 0
x += 1

title: 02 · Constant conditions and cleanup
source:
# Cleanup marks the condition always_false; codegen visits only the else branch.
if false
  1
else
  2
end

title: 03 · Method specialization
source:
# Compare the Int32 and Float64 specializations of the same method.
def identity(x)
  x
end

identity(1)
identity(1.0)

title: 04 · Overload resolution
source:
# Each call selects a different Def; compare this with example 03.
def identity(x : Int32)
  x
end

def identity(x : Float64)
  x
end

identity(1)
identity(1.0)

title: 05 · Before a type error
source:
# Inspect the operations recorded before the incompatible argument is rejected.
1 + "a"

title: 06 · Union types and narrowing
source:
# The branches produce Int32 | String; is_a? narrows it inside each branch.
value = true ? 1 : "a"

if value.is_a?(Int32)
  value
else
  value
end

  end

title: 09 · Macro-generated AST
source:
# Compare this call with the expanded AST: 3 * 3.
macro square(x)
  {{x}} * {{x}}
end

square(3)
